summary: June CPI came in weaker than expected, lifting stocks and pushing bonds lower as markets repriced Fed rate-hike odds — consistent with equities in Greed while bonds and gold lag. Oil eased off highs after Trump abandoned his demand for ships to pay a transit fee through the Strait of Hormuz, but geopolitical risk persists.
tweet: Softer CPI fueled a tech-led equity rally, but 30Y yields near 5.1% and Strait of Hormuz uncertainty keep bonds under pressure and gold in Fear territory.
